set.body: Slice CR6b: forms for the recipe fields of the three plans (grid, window, scales, px/deg, initial fixations, failure policy, pairing, phases), factory defaults only; the Phrase/MethodsText token model producing the S7.2 sentence and the S9.4 methods text; a 'form complete' obligation added to FamilyConformanceSuite. After CR6a.
set.title: CR6b: study, recording and temporal forms and the methods-text model
